newsitem.title: AFGHANISTAN: Firing erupts after nightfall in Kabul.
newsitem.headline: Firing erupts after nightfall in Kabul.

text.p: Firing erupted across the Afghan capital Kabul after nightfall on Monday, witnesses said.

Tracer rounds could be seen across the sky and the sound of anti-aircraft guns, small arms and machine guns, and occasional artillery could be heard from about 1330 GMT. There was no immediate explanation but it was reminiscent of 1992 when mujahideen guerrillas captured Kabul, unleashing thousands of rounds in a victory celebration.
